title: Effectivity of coherent pseudococones over filtered category colimits
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category and $D:J\to\mathsf{Cat}$ a strict diagram of small categories [def-nagata-category, def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $c$ be a cocone such that the induced cocones of object sets and complete arrow sets are colimits of sets [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor, lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-categories]. Write $C=c.\mathrm{pt}$ and $v_i:D(i)\to C$ for its structure functors, and write a pseudococone as $(A_i,\theta)$. For every category $A$ in arbitrary containing object and morphism universes, each coherent pseudococone $P\in\operatorname{PCone}(D,A)$ [def-per-strict-diagram-pseudococones] is isomorphic to the restriction of some functor $F:c.\mathrm{pt}\to A$. Equivalently, the specified restriction functor is essentially surjective. No full-faithfulness assertion is included.

source.place: Tag 04AX (section-directed-colimits), finite-representative extension: Steps 1--2 of lem-per-filtered-category-pseudococones; not asserted verbatim by the tag.

proof.text:
For a pseudococone $(A_i,\theta)$, use the canonical transports $T$ of [lem-per-filtered-pseudocone-representative-transport]. Choose a representative $r_z=(i_z,x_z)$ for each object $z$ of $C$, possible by the object colimit, and set $F(z)=A_{i_z}(x_z)$. If $h:z\to z'$ is represented by $f:x\to y$ in $D(i)$, define
$$F(h)=T_{(i,y),r_{z'}}\,A_i(f)\,T_{r_z,(i,x)}.$$
Every arrow has such a representative by [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-categories]. The transport square for two equal arrow representatives, and the identity $T_{qr}T_{pq}=T_{pr}$, give the same displayed value for any representative. Thus this is an actual map on each Hom set, with the required endpoints.

source.place: Tag 04AX (section-directed-colimits), eventual equality of representatives. The conjugation and modification identities below are an agent formulation extending that representative calculus; they are not asserted verbatim by this tag.

proof.text:
Lift a composable pair of arrows of $C$, their composite and their endpoint relations to one stage using [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-categories]. In the formula for $F(g)F(f)$ the two transports at the middle object multiply to the identity; functoriality of $A_i$ then gives $F(gf)$. The same computation with an identity arrow gives $F(1_z)=1_{F(z)}$. Define $\lambda_{i,x}=T_{r_{v_i x},(i,x)}:F(v_i x)\to A_i(x)$. The transport square makes $\lambda_i$ natural. For $a:i\to k$, the transition formula $T_{(i,x),(k,D(a)x)}=\theta_{a,x}^{-1}$ gives
$$\lambda_{i,x}=\theta_{a,x}\lambda_{k,D(a)x}.$$
Consequently $\lambda$ is an isomorphism in $\operatorname{PCone}(D,\mathcal A)$ from the restriction of $F$ to $(A_i,\theta)$. This proves essential surjectivity of restriction.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredPseudococone_effective
    {J : Type z} [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (D : J ⥤ Cat.{z, z})
    (c : Cocone D) (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone c))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone c))
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] :
    (StrictDiagramPseudococone.restriction c A).EssSurj
